Meet JADA

Music with soul.
Stories with weight.

Jada Lee is a singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and creative entrepreneur from Hertfordshire, England. Her work centres on powerful vocals, musicianship, live performance and storytelling that connects.

About the artist

ROOTED IN
MUSIC.
BUILT TO MOVE.

JADA creates music and experiences centred around storytelling, emotional connection and creative expression. Her influences range from Donny Hathaway, Jill Scott and Ella Fitzgerald to Brandy, Tina Turner, Beyoncé and Whitney Houston. Alongside her work as an artist, she is the founder of Synapse Recordings, supporting emerging creatives through performance opportunities, masterclasses and collaborative spaces.
